prospective_f3b_changes: true period is sampled continuously inside the reviewer-mandated 40–300 s support rather than only the three F1 period grid points
background identities will be new F3B identities rather than F1 data_seed values
secondary deterministic gap/quality challenge masks are added only for the INPUT_ADMISSIBILITY plane

red_noise_component.nyquist_rule: for even n_samples, final complex draw replaced by one extra real normal draw
red_noise_component.standardization: subtract sample mean; divide by sample std ddof=1; multiply by 0.005
red_noise_component.generation_failure_policy: non-finite or zero-std realization is retained as generation failure and is never redrawn

white_noise_component.note: No independent photometric white-noise term is added in the primary generator. alpha=0 is the white-spectrum Fourier-background case.
white_noise_component.limitation: The bound F1 inputs provide no prospectively validated independent white-noise amplitude interval; none is invented in F3B.1.

coherence_parameterization.reason: The primary truth model contains no separate damping/linewidth parameter.

quality_gap_mask.application_stage: after full latent flux construction; before AFINO input eligibility
quality_gap_mask.prevalence_interpretation: PROHIBITED; challenge regimes are not observational frequency estimates

composition_order: generate one power-law stochastic background realization
generate one independent QPP phase for the paired background realization
materialize synthetic null or synthetic QPP-positive latent flux
apply the prospectively assigned quality/gap mask without interpolation
only eligible inputs may proceed to AFINO classification metrics

rng_contract.draw_order: preserve F1 Fourier real-vector, imaginary-vector, even-N Nyquist real draw, then independent uniform phase

versioning_rule: Any generator-semantic change after phase3b-design-v1 requires a new phase3b-design-v2 freeze before generating further data.
prohibited_generator_changes_after_freez: change signal family without new design freeze
change period support or qpp_fraction values after observing development results
change noise slopes or normalization after observing results
use real observational backgrounds as primary synthetic null truth
known_limitations: Primary flare morphology is the fixed validated F1 asymmetric envelope, not an empirical distribution of flare shapes.
Independent photometric white noise is fixed to zero because no bound source supplies a validated amplitude domain.
Per-realization Fourier noise is standardized to a fixed sample standard deviation as in F1.
Primary QPP family has no extra damping or chirp; secondary stress families remain unresolved.
Gap/quality challenge regimes are design stress tests and must not be prevalence-weighted as observational frequencies.
